instruction: Use a Fusion 360 API script or command-line automation workflow for Fusion-compatible CAM generation. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_table_plate.step, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_table.csv. Read C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_table.csv and machine all ten listed holes on C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_table_plate.step. Through holes must break through the bottom by 1 mm, and blind holes must follow the depth in the CSV. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-24.nc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_result.json with one record per hole containing x, y, diameter, depth, and type. Tool definitions: use the drilling tools needed for the diameters and through/blind depths listed in C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_table.csv. Write the output file(s) to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-24.nc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\hole_result.json.
